pages.text: A main building — hatchery, command center or nexus — placed from a spawn egg founds your base: 50 minerals and 4 workers. One base per dimension, shared by all three races.

A map ringed with 8 armor shards of a race makes its supply platform. Placed, it is a building of its race: monsters and the wild races attack it. Lay $(l)100 minerals$() in it and use the command panel on it: a transport brings a worker, who founds your base there.

Workers bring what they gather to the nearest $(l)storage$(): a main building or a supply platform. They take $(l)minerals first$(); only where there are none other valuable blocks. All storages are one bank of minerals and vespene: open any of them like a chest — minerals show as mineral shards; anything valuable laid in turns into minerals by its worth.
Units and buildings cost only $(l)minerals and vespene$(), as in StarCraft II. Build the main building with a worker when you have its price.
